summary: Enabled a persistent firewalld configuration on node1 (CentOS Stream 10) permitting SSH and TCP/8080 while rejecting all other unrelated inbound traffic, then verified persistence across a full node reboot.
actions_performed: Confirmed firewalld active/enabled and iptables/nft available on node1
Added permanent ssh service (already present) and permanent 8080/tcp port to the public zone, then reloaded firewalld
Verified default zone target rejects unmatched inbound traffic via nft ruleset (reject with icmpx admin-prohibited)
Verified only ssh(22), cockpit(9090 via cockpit service), dhcpv6-client, and 8080/tcp are in the allow chain
Confirmed firewalld is systemctl-enabled for boot persistence and permanent config matches runtime config
Captured baseline boot_id and healthy firewall state
Issued a native reboot (shutdown -r now) that acknowledged before disconnecting
Polled node1 until reachable again and confirmed boot_id changed, proving an actual restart
Re-verified post-reboot that firewalld is active and the persistent ssh+8080 allow rules and default-reject behavior survived the restart

evidence.requirement: Persistent firewall permits SSH and TCP 8080, rejects unrelated inbound (pre-reboot)
evidence.summary: firewalld active on CentOS Stream 10; public zone permanently configured with ssh service and 8080/tcp port, firewalld enabled at boot; nft ruleset shows explicit reject-by-default and an allow chain limited to tcp/22, tcp/9090 (cockpit), and tcp/8080

evidence.requirement: Node1 mandatory restart: healthy baseline capture
evidence.summary: Captured baseline boot_id (4d340bf4-0579-47f0-98c1-5c17a66d50f1) plus healthy firewalld active state and full ruleset as pre-restart baseline

evidence.requirement: Node1 mandatory restart: acknowledged restart command
evidence.summary: Issued backgrounded 'shutdown -r now'; exec stream closed as the node went down, confirming the restart was triggered

evidence.requirement: Node1 mandatory restart: changed boot identity proof
evidence.summary: Polled node1 through connection-timeout/reset states until reachable; new boot_id 57cee3d9-a876-4295-89b9-34adb354d9b0 differs from baseline, proving an actual restart occurred

evidence.requirement: Node1 mandatory restart: post-restart recovery of required service/config
evidence.summary: Post-reboot firewalld is active with identical persistent zone config (ssh + 8080/tcp allowed) and identical nft allow-chain, confirming firewall rules survived the restart
